title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
abstract: arXiv:2610.04693v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agents are entering finance, healthcare and law, sectors where a violation leaves no lexical signature and carries real penalties. Whether an omission is material, or a disclosure sufficient, depends on what the response left out. Probing such an obligation means finding responses one minimal edit from flipping compliance, and every probe costs a generation and two adjudications, so the binding constraint on regulatory red-teaming is sample efficiency, not volume. We introduce Penumbra, an adversarial search that walks from a verified anchor under an expanding edit budget until a two-evaluator committee changes its verdict, and emits the two adjacent responses that straddle the change. Allocation is adaptive, and the objective is coverage of the defeat surface: distinct (obligation x defeat mode) cells resolved per candidate. At matched budget, adaptive allocation reaches uniform allocation's full-budget coverage on 59% of the candid

translated_title: Penumbra（半影）：面向监管义务的样本高效对抗搜索
translated_abstract: 智能体正在进入金融、医疗和法律领域，在这些领域中，违规行为不会留下词汇层面的痕迹，却会带来真实的处罚。一项遗漏是否重要、一项披露是否充分，取决于回复所遗漏的内容。探测这类监管义务意味着找到那些只需一次最小编辑就能使合规状态翻转的回复，而每次探测的代价是一次生成加两次裁定，因此监管红队测试的关键约束是样本效率，而非数量。我们提出Penumbra，一种对抗性搜索方法：它从一个经验证的锚点出发，在不断扩大的编辑预算下进行搜索，直到由两个评估器组成的委员会改变判定结果，并输出跨越这一变化的两个相邻回复。资源分配是自适应的，目标是对“失效面”的覆盖：即每个候选所解析出的不同（义务×失效模式）单元格。在相同预算下，自适应分配在59%的候选项上达到了均匀分配全额预算所实现的覆盖率……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 提出Penumbra，一种样本高效的对抗搜索方法，通过从经验证的锚点出发自适应地分配编辑预算，找到使监管合规判定翻转的最小编辑相邻回复对，从而以更少的探测成本最大化覆盖监管义务的“失效面”。
en_tdlr: Penumbra is a sample-efficient adversarial search that adaptively allocates an expanding edit budget from a verified anchor to find adjacent response pairs straddling a regulatory compliance verdict change, maximizing coverage of the (obligation × defeat mode) defeat surface under constrained probe budgets.
